note:
Improve Line Breaks Filter provides one filter plugin (id improve_line_breaks_filter, type TYPE_TRANSFORM_IRREVERSIBLE, weight 50) with a single boolean setting remove_empty_paragraphs (default FALSE = replace empty

with
, TRUE = delete). No configure route, no permissions, no Drush, no plugin types. State lives inside a text format's config at filter.format..filters.improve_line_breaks_filter (status + settings.remove_empty_paragraphs). Medium/hard cases create namespaced text formats (ilbf_*) and read/write that real filter config.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal improve_line_breaks_filter module do to content, and what is the filter plugin id you would enable on a text format?
evals.expected_output:
It provides a text filter (plugin id improve_line_breaks_filter, 'Improve line breaks') that replaces empty paragraphs like

and

 

with
(or removes them). You enable it on a text format's Enabled filters.

evals.prompt: The improve_line_breaks_filter has one setting. What is it called, what does it do, and where is it stored?
evals.expected_output:
The setting is remove_empty_paragraphs (boolean, default FALSE). FALSE replaces empty paragraphs with
; TRUE deletes them. It is stored in the text format config at filter.format..filters.improve_line_breaks_filter.settings.remove_empty_paragraphs.

evals.prompt: There is no settings page for improve_line_breaks_filter. How do I actually turn it on for content, and which core module does it depend on?
evals.expected_output: It is a filter, so you enable it per text format at Configuration > Content authoring > Text formats and editors (/admin/config/content/formats) by ticking 'Improve line breaks' in Enabled filters. It depends only on core filter.

evals.prompt:
This site has a text format named ilbf_known with the improve_line_breaks_filter enabled. Inspect the live configuration: when this filter runs on that format, does it replace empty paragraphs with
or delete them entirely? Name the setting and its value.
evals.expected_output: It deletes empty paragraphs: filter.format.ilbf_known filters.improve_line_breaks_filter.settings.remove_empty_paragraphs is TRUE.

evals.prompt:
The text format ilbf_replace on this site has the improve_line_breaks_filter enabled. Inspect its live configuration and state whether empty paragraphs are replaced with
or removed, based on the remove_empty_paragraphs setting.
evals.expected_output:
Empty paragraphs are replaced with
, not deleted, because filter.format.ilbf_replace filters.improve_line_breaks_filter.settings.remove_empty_paragraphs is FALSE.

evals.prompt: This site has a text format ilbf_task that does not currently run the improve_line_breaks_filter. Enable the 'Improve line breaks' filter on the ilbf_task text format and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the filter on the format, e.g. FilterFormat::load('ilbf_task')->setFilterConfig('improve_line_breaks_filter', ['status' => TRUE, 'weight' => 50, 'settings' => ['remove_empty_paragraphs' => FALSE]])->save(); so filter.format.ilbf_task filters.improve_line_breaks_filter.status is TRUE.

evals.prompt:
On the ilbf_remove text format the improve_line_breaks_filter is already enabled but currently replaces empty paragraphs with
. Reconfigure it so it instead deletes empty paragraphs entirely, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set remove_empty_paragraphs to TRUE on the filter for that format, keeping it enabled: filter.format.ilbf_remove filters.improve_line_breaks_filter.settings.remove_empty_paragraphs = TRUE (status still TRUE).
